propositions: Approved maintainability ratchets for function complexity, Mypy settings, and Ruff rules must be enforced incrementally across multiple independent stories to account for existing diagnostics without breaking builds.

Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) and Ruff ASYNC/DTZ rules must be enabled after revalidating measured diagnostics and resolving pre-existing violations.
Function complexity (C901) must be enforced via a shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 integrated into the canonical lint gate, with all pre-existing violations captured in the baseline.

Ruff RUF hygiene diagnostics must be cleared and enforced while deferring RUF001, RUF002, RUF003 for future work, with a shared test harness (test_ruff_ratchet.py) created and extended across dependent stories.
